messages.content:
Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

On 1 December 2026 the manufacturer of a machine in a category listed in Annex IV to Directive 2006/42/EC, not built to harmonised standards, wants to place it on the market using unit verification (module G) instead of EC type-examination or full quality assurance. Is that procedure admitted by the act applicable on that day?

response.text: Under Directive 2006/42/EC, as it applies on 1 December 2026, would a manufacturer of a machine falling within a category listed in Annex IV and not built to harmonised standards be permitted to place it on the market by means of unit verification (module G), rather than through EC type-examination or full quality assurance?
